name: Build Your Own Redis
description: Implement a Redis-like in-memory key-value store with RESP protocol support.
readme:
# Build Your Own Redis

Implement a simplified Redis server in Rust.

## Stages

1. TCP Server: Accept connections and handle the RESP protocol basics
2. String Commands: Implement GET, SET, DEL, PING
3. Expiry: Support TTL and expiration of keys
4. Lists: Implement LPUSH, RPUSH, LPOP, RPOP, LRANGE
5. Persistence: Save and load database snapshots to disk

## Getting Started

Each stage builds on the previous one. Start with stage 1.
